_note: Filled from source 2026-09-02. Every value extracted programmatically, not transcribed: the PHP side by dumping config('ichava.core.svg.*') inside a booted Testbench app (standing rule 3 -- the shipped config is the effective policy, not the trait fallback), the JS side by parsing the allow-list arrays out of sanitizeSvg.ts. Regenerate rather than hand-edit.
_scope: This file models the TWO runtimes census.mjs understands. There are FOUR. See _unmodelled_runtimes.

server._source: core/config/core.php -> ichava.core.svg.* (21 tags, 43 attributes, 7 forbidden tags), plus SanitizesSvg::isAllowedAttribute() which admits xmlns/id/class/href/xlink:href/role and any /^aria-[a-z]+$/ in code rather than config.
server._value_restrictions: By-name allow-listing is all census.mjs can model. Two attributes here are value-restricted in code and the census cannot see it: href/xlink:href survive only as ^#[A-Za-z_][\w.:-]*$ fragments, and style rejects non-fragment url(), expression(, behavior: and -moz-binding.
server._aria_prefix: aria-* is allowed by shape, not by list. aria-labelledby and aria-describedby are enumerated below so the census sees them; the real rule is the regex.

client._source: browser/resources/assets/scripts/ichava-ts/utils/sanitizeSvg.ts -- SVG_TAG_ALLOWLIST, SVG_ATTR_ALLOWLIST and the FORBID_TAGS/FORBID_ATTR passed to DOMPurify.
client._caveat: USE_PROFILES: { svg: true, svgFilters: false } is also passed. DOMPurify merges profile tags into ALLOWED_TAGS, so the effective client tag set is a superset of the list below. The census will therefore over-report client stripping for tags DOMPurify's svg profile happens to allow. Attributes are NOT similarly widened, so the attribute rows are exact.

_unmodelled_runtimes.react_client: react-browser/src/core/sanitizeSvg.ts -- a THIRD policy, not a copy of the Vue one despite its header comment. Uses USE_PROFILES { svg: true, svgFilters: true } so it allows filter/fe* which PHP strips, and enforces fragment-only href through an afterSanitizeAttributes hook rather than a list.
_unmodelled_runtimes.python_build: maintainer-toolkit/src/ichava_maintainer_toolkit/core/transforms/sanitise.py -- a FOURTH, 61 lines of regex that only match double-quoted attributes, so a single-quoted or unquoted on*= handler passes the build-time gate untouched.
_unmodelled_runtimes._why_here: census.mjs models a server/client pair. Recording the other two here so the divergence table this file produces is read as a lower bound, not the whole picture. Collapsing all four onto security/svg-policy.json is phase P4.
